summary: Regression testing after Supabase flowType:'pkce' change (Android deep-link Google OAuth fix). Backend: all 14 pytest cases pass (login admin/bob, register, wrong-password, supabase config, supabase-login contract, signed-upload-url, admin reports, feed, /auth/me via bearer, refresh via body). Frontend: admin login->/feed in 0.34s with Admin nav present, /admin loads, logout from /settings clears token in 0.04s and returns to '/', bob login->/feed in 0.33s. No runtime error overlay. Google OAuth not tested per instructions.

issues: Console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — hydration warning from a <select><option> that wraps a <span>. Unrelated to this iteration's flowType change but worth cleaning up.

critical_code_review_comments: supabase.js flowType:'pkce' is a safe global switch. Note detectSessionInUrl remains true which is correct for web; for the Capacitor deep-link flow the app must explicitly call supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code) with the ?code=... extracted from the clanchat:// URL — confirm AuthContext deep-link handler does this (line ~255) and logs errors.
React hydration warning (<span> inside <option>) still present in AppShell — pre-existing, low priority, but suppress by moving the icon/text out of the raw <option>.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_user_{uuid}@clanchat.app created by test_register_new_user (module-level pytest test). Not cleaned up automatically — DB accumulates one TEST_ user per run. Recommend a teardown fixture that deletes users whose email starts with 'TEST_'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: flowType:'pkce' regression run — no impact on legacy email/password flows. Onboarding tour did not overlay on repeat logins (already dismissed for these seeded users). Preview: https://clan-chat-fix.preview.emergentagent.com. Login selectors: input[type='email'], input[type='password'], [data-testid='login-submit']. Logout: /settings -> [data-testid='logout-btn']. Google OAuth intentionally NOT tested (Android-only PKCE deep link).
rca of the issue: No regression detected. flowType:'pkce' only changes how OAuth session tokens are returned (query ?code= vs #fragment). It does not affect signInWithPassword (email/password) or the legacy /api/auth/login JWT path, which the frontend now tries first. Both paths verified end-to-end.
